newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol to operate refinery in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Repsol to operate refinery in Egypt.

text.p: Spanish energy group Repsol said on Monday that it will participate in the construction and operation of one of the largest refineries in the Middle East in the free zone of Alexandria.

Repsol president Alfonso Cortina will on Tuesday sign a general accord to regulate Repsol's participation in the project with Hussein Salem, president of the Middle East Oil Refinery (Midor), it said in a statement.

Egypt's Midor consortium is a joint venture between the Hussein K. Salem Group of Egypt, which owns 40 percent, Israel's Merhav Group, with 40 percent, and the Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) with 20 percent.
Repsol has an option to buy 10 percent of the capital of the group, which could be raised to 20 percent.
Repsol can act as a representative of the property to supervise engineering, the purchase of materials and the construction of the entire project.
In addition, it will be the technical operator of the refinery and will supply the raw materials as well as the commercialization of the products.
